name: heartbeat-drums
style: Cinematic percussion-only cue, 150 bpm racing irregular heartbeat played as lub-dub double strikes on huge taiko and floor toms with a dry close-miked drum kit, rim clicks on the off-beats, beats skipping and stumbling, then dragging slower and slower until one last faint thud and a dead stop. Spoken voices barked in time with the drum hits, breathless and desperate: a husky alto woman, a tight nasal baritone man, a hoarse high-pitched shouting man at the wheel. A low detuned siren smeared into a droning hum beneath the toms. A fruity theatrical posh tenor heard muffled through glass, underwater and distant. Monitor beeps, ragged breaths, rain hiss. Ends on one flat sine monitor tone, then silence. ER trauma-bay urgency, no melody, no chords.
exclude: melody, chords, piano, strings, synth pad, guitar, bass line, singing, choir, harmony, uk drill, rap flow, trap hi-hats, cheerful, comedy, upbeat, fade out
lyrics:
[Intro: frantic irregular heartbeat on taiko toms, low siren hum]
[Spoken, shouted on the beat, husky alto woman]
Sixty over thirty! Fucking hurry up, we're gonna lose him!
[Spoken, clipped, tight nasal baritone man]
Sats dropping, he's peri-arrest!
[Shouted, hoarse high-pitched driver]
Two minutes out! Get the fuck out of the way!
[Heartbeat stumbles, skips, slows]
[Spoken, baritone man]
Why have we stopped?!
[Muffled, underwater, far away, posh tenor]
I said raspberry-shaped hors d'oeuvres!
[Heartbeat almost gone, one faint tom]
[Spoken, quiet, alto woman]
Fifty over twen—
[Flatline tone]
[Silence]
[End]
